surah.personality_title: An-Naba — The Tremendous Announcement & The Horizon of Reckoning
surah.personality_summary: Interrogative, majestic, awe-inspiring, cosmic. Opens with the disbelievers' contentious questioning regarding the Great News of resurrection, answers through the vast panoramic signposts of creation (earth as a bed, mountains as pegs, sleep as rest, sun as a blazing lamp), and confronts mankind with the Day of Sorting where transgressors meet Hell and the righteous enter attainment.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah An-Naba (The Announcement) is the 78th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 40 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ عَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم عم يتساءلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: About what are they asking one another
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What are they asking about

ayahs.translation_saheeh: About the great news
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The momentous announcement

ayahs.translation_saheeh: That over which they are in disagreement
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: about which they differ

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! They are going to know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will find out

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then, no! They are going to know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: In the end they will find out

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have We not made the earth a resting place
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We not make the earth smooth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the mountains as stakes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and make the mountains to keep it stable

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We created you in pairs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We not create you in pairs

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: give you sleep for rest

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And made the night as clothing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the night as a cover

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And made the day for livelihood
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the day for your livelihood

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعࣰ ا شِدَادࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We not build seven strong [heavens] above you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And made [therein] a burning lamp
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and make a blazing lamp

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءࣰ ثَجَّاجࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We not send water pouring down from the clouds

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبࣰّ ا وَنَبَاتࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to bring forth with it grain, plants

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And gardens of entwined growth
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and luxuriant gardens

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: A time has been appointed for the Day of Decision

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم ينفخ في الصور فتاتون افواجا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a Day when the Trumpet will sound and you will come forward in crowds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the sky will open up like wide portals

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the mountains will vanish like a mirage

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Hell lies in wait

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For the transgressors, a place of return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a home for oppressors

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In which they will remain for ages [unending]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to stay in for a long, long time

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدࣰ ا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا يذوقون فيها بردا ولا شرابا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: where they will taste no coolness nor drink

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: except one that is scalding and dark––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: An appropriate recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a fitting requital

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for they did not fear a reckoning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and they rejected Our messages as lies

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But all things We have enumerated in writing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have recorded everything in a Record

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Taste this: all you will get from Us is more torment.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: For those who were aware of God there is supreme fulfilment

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Gardens and grapevines
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: private gardens, vineyards

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: nubile, well-matched companions

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And a full cup
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and an overflowing cup

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوࣰ ا وَلَا كِذَّٰبࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا كذابا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There they will hear no vain or lying talk

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: جَزَآءࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a reward from your Lord, a fitting gift

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: رب السماوات والارض وما بينهما الرحمن ۖ لا يملكون منه خطابا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: from the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Lord of Mercy. They will have no authority from Him to speak

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفࣰّ اۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم يقوم الروح والملائكة صفا ۖ لا يتكلمون الا من اذن له الرحمن وقال صوابا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in rows, they will not speak except for those to whom the Lord of Mercy gives permission, who will say only what is right

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ مَآبًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ذلك اليوم الحق ۖ فمن شاء اتخذ الى ربه مابا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: That is the Day of Truth. So whoever wishes to do so should take the path that leads to his Lord

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا قَرِيبࣰ ا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا أَنْذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ تُرَابًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا انذرناكم عذابا قريبا يوم ينظر المرء ما قدمت يداه ويقول الكافر يا ليتني كنت ترابا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have warned you of imminent torment, on the Day when every person will see what their own hands have sent ahead for them, when the disbeliever will say, ‘If only I were dust!’
